ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Tender and estimate, Go or no-go and later stages need Tender deadline and Go or no-go.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Tender_estimate", CASE(StageName, "Opportunity", 1, "Go or no-go", 2, "Estimating", 3, "Bid submitted", 4, "Clarification", 5, "Preferred bidder", 6, "Awarded", 7, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Tender_deadline__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Go_no_go__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Tender deadline and Go or no-go before moving to Go or no-go.
